StudyLab study packs - database revision preview

Practise with original questions, try a timed exam and compare your work with explained answers. Start with the free sample below.

Database Revision Pack

Status: pilot review. Not yet for sale. Payments and accounts are not enabled. The complete pilot is being reviewed privately before a release decision.

  • 24 SQL exercises, from filtering and joins to safe changes and SQL Server scripts.
  • 6 normalisation case studies with 1NF, 2NF and 3NF dependency diagrams.
  • A 100-mark practice exam, suggested time 90 minutes, with a separate marking guide.
  • A practice dataset with 20 students, 6 courses and 23 enrolments.
  • Worked answers and editable source material.

This is supplementary revision for DATA6211 and DATA6222, not an official or institution-endorsed examination paper.

Download the free sample

The five-page sample includes three SQL questions and their answers, plus a student-course normalisation case with diagrams from 1NF to 3NF. Try the questions before opening the answer pages.

Download free sample PDFDownload SQLite practice datasetDownload SQL Server practice dataset

Use a separate empty practice database. Setup scripts reset four named teaching tables. Read the script comments before running them. SQLite and SQL Server use different environments; choose the matching file. The files do not upload your data.

How to use this pack

  1. Read the schema and setup notes, then create the practice database.
  2. Write a query or draw your dependency diagram before looking at the answer.
  3. Run SQL in your chosen database tool and inspect missing values, ties and unmatched rows.
  4. Compare your explanation with the worked solution. Use the free lessons to revise weak topics.

Native SQL Server procedures, OUTPUT and TRY/CATCH in the complete pilot still require an actual SQL Server test before commercial release. The sample focuses on portable query and design exercises.

Existing free resources stay available

StudyLab already provides free question sheets, answers and revision slides. You can continue using those and saving progress in your browser without creating an account.
